name: stats-section
title: Stats Section
description: A tall dark band with a lavender glow at its edges. One side holds a small label, a two-line headline and four big facts in a two-by-two grid; the other side holds two short paragraphs split by a hairline.
use: An about page wants to pair four founding facts with a short mission statement in one tall band.
avoid: Light themes: the near-black surface, grey copy and purple edge glow are hardcoded, and all text is fixed.
a11y: Display-only content with no controls; the hover glow has no keyboard equivalent and the entrance ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A near-black section fading into deep purple at the bottom corners. Left: a thin outlined uppercase pill, a huge heading whose second line is grey, then large figures for 2023, 100%, $2.5M and 50+ with tiny spaced labels. Right: two grey paragraphs divided by a short thin line.
behaves: The four facts slide in from the left one after another when the section enters view. Hovering the paragraph column slowly raises a soft white glow behind the text.
customise: All four figures, labels, the heading and both paragraphs are written in the file; the purple glow and greys need source edits.
weight: light: Four short slide-ins and a CSS hover glow; nothing animates after entry.
demo: Pill "Agency Metrics", heading "Our Existence Explained.", facts for Founded, Remote, Capital and Partners.
issues: In later frames the right-hand paragraphs are clipped at the frame edge.
The grey second heading line and tiny uppercase labels sit low contrast on black.
polishWhy: Well balanced editorial split with a restrained glow; body copy and labels are dim.
